StudyRoom.title: StudyRoom
StudyRoom.description: A real-time multiplayer Study Battle quiz room identified by a 4-letter uppercase room code.

hostId.description: Client-generated host identifier for authoritative room control.

title.description: Title of the study battle quiz.

currentQuestionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the active question.

questionStartedAtMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the active question timer started.

questionDurationSec.description: Countdown duration per question in seconds (15).

answersLocked.description: Whether answers for the active question are locked by the host.

questions.description: List of 1 to 50 multiple-choice quiz questions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest host state transition.

StudyPlayer.title: StudyPlayer
StudyPlayer.description: A participant inside a Study Battle room with real-time score and streak.

playerId.description: Unique player identifier within the room.

displayName.description: Player's display name shown in the lobby and podium.

score.description: Cumulative score awarded by the host.

lastPointsEarned.description: Points earned on the most recently graded question.

lastAnswerCorrect.description: Whether the most recently graded question was answered correctly.

isHost.description: Whether this participant is also playing as the host.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player joined.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest score update.

StudyAnswer.title: StudyAnswer
StudyAnswer.description: A single player's locked answer submission for a specific question index.

playerId.description: ID of the player submitting the answer.

answeredAtMs.description: Client timestamp when the option was selected.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the answer was recorded.

/studyRooms/{roomCode}.description: Live Study Battle rooms keyed by 4-letter uppercase join codes.

/studyRooms/{roomCode}/players/{playerId.description: Players participating in a specific Study Battle room.

/studyRooms/{roomCode}/answers/{answerId.description: Submitted multiple-choice answers per question and player for host grading.
